---
title: "Luke"
---

# Luke

::: {.book-summary}
## Book Summary Insight

Luke portrays Jesus as the compassionate Savior for all people. The book emphasizes God's grace toward the outcast, the poor, and the nations.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 1

<div class="key-verse">Luke 1:37</div>

<div class="identifier">For with God nothing shall be impossible</div>

### Why This Verse

One of the most quoted promises in Scripture

### Chapter Insight

This chapter records the announcements of the births of John the Baptist and Jesus. The key verse highlights God's faithfulness in fulfilling His promises through His appointed Savior.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 2

<div class="key-verse">Luke 2:11</div>

<div class="identifier">Unto you is born this day a Savior</div>

### Why This Verse

Central Christmas proclamation

### Chapter Insight

This chapter recounts Jesus' birth, dedication, and childhood. The key verse presents Christ as the Savior brought for all people.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 3

<div class="key-verse">Luke 3:16</div>

<div class="identifier">He shall baptize you with the Holy Ghost and with fire</div>

### Why This Verse

John the Baptist's prophecy

### Chapter Insight

This chapter introduces John the Baptist's ministry and Jesus' baptism. The key verse calls for repentance demonstrated through transformed lives.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 4

<div class="key-verse">Luke 4:18</div>

<div class="identifier">The Spirit of the Lord is upon Me</div>

### Why This Verse

Jesus' mission statement

### Chapter Insight

This chapter records Jesus' temptation and the beginning of His public ministry. The key verse reveals Jesus as the fulfillment of God's promise to bring good news and freedom.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 5

<div class="key-verse">Luke 5:32</div>

<div class="identifier">I came not to call the righteous, but sinners to repentance</div>

### Why This Verse

Purpose of Christ's ministry

### Chapter Insight

This chapter contains the calling of the first disciples and miraculous healings. The key verse emphasizes leaving everything behind to follow Christ.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 6

<div class="key-verse">Luke 6:31</div>

<div class="identifier">As ye would that men should do to you</div>

### Why This Verse

The Golden Rule

### Chapter Insight

This chapter teaches about discipleship, love, and kingdom living. The key verse calls believers to love even their enemies.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 7

<div class="key-verse">Luke 7:47</div>

<div class="identifier">Her sins, which are many, are forgiven</div>

### Why This Verse

Grace and forgiveness

### Chapter Insight

This chapter demonstrates Jesus' compassion and authority through miracles. The key verse highlights faith as the proper response to Christ.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 8

<div class="key-verse">Luke 8:50</div>

<div class="identifier">Fear not: believe only</div>

### Why This Verse

Jairus' daughter

### Chapter Insight

This chapter contains parables, miracles, and demonstrations of faith. The key verse emphasizes hearing God's Word and responding with perseverance.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 9

<div class="key-verse">Luke 9:23</div>

<div class="identifier">If any man will come after Me, let him deny himself</div>

### Why This Verse

Core discipleship verse

### Chapter Insight

This chapter records the sending of the twelve, Peter's confession, and the Transfiguration. The key verse emphasizes that true discipleship requires denying oneself and following Christ.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 10

<div class="key-verse">Luke 10:27</div>

<div class="identifier">Love the Lord thy God... and thy neighbor</div>

### Why This Verse

Greatest commandment summary

### Chapter Insight

This chapter contains the mission of the seventy-two, the Good Samaritan, and Mary and Martha. The key verse teaches that love for God and neighbor fulfills God's will.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 11

<div class="key-verse">Luke 11:9</div>

<div class="identifier">Ask, and it shall be given you</div>

### Why This Verse

Famous teaching on prayer

### Chapter Insight

This chapter teaches about prayer and warns against spiritual hypocrisy. The key verse encourages persistent prayer and dependence upon God.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 12

<div class="key-verse">Luke 12:34</div>

<div class="identifier">Where your treasure is, there will your heart be also</div>

### Why This Verse

Heart and priorities

### Chapter Insight

This chapter addresses fear, greed, worry, and readiness. The key verse calls believers to seek God's kingdom above earthly concerns.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 13

<div class="key-verse">Luke 13:24</div>

<div class="identifier">Strive to enter in at the strait gate</div>

### Why This Verse

Call to salvation

### Chapter Insight

This chapter emphasizes repentance and the growth of God's kingdom. The key verse reveals God's desire to gather and save His people.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 14

<div class="key-verse">Luke 14:11</div>

<div class="identifier">He that humbleth himself shall be exalted</div>

### Why This Verse

Kingdom principle

### Chapter Insight

This chapter teaches humility, hospitality, and the cost of discipleship. The key verse stresses counting the cost before following Christ.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 15

<div class="key-verse">Luke 15:7</div>

<div class="identifier">Joy in heaven over one sinner that repenteth</div>

### Why This Verse

Heart of the lost sheep parable

### Chapter Insight

This chapter contains the parables of the lost sheep, lost coin, and prodigal son. The key verse highlights God's joy over repentant sinners.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 16

<div class="key-verse">Luke 16:13</div>

<div class="identifier">Ye cannot serve God and mammon</div>

### Why This Verse

Loyalty and wealth

### Chapter Insight

This chapter addresses stewardship, wealth, and eternal priorities. The key verse teaches that faithfulness in small things reflects true spiritual character.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 17

<div class="key-verse">Luke 17:21</div>

<div class="identifier">The kingdom of God is within you (or among you)</div>

### Why This Verse

Frequently discussed kingdom verse

### Chapter Insight

This chapter teaches about forgiveness, faith, gratitude, and the coming kingdom. The key verse highlights thankful faith through the healing of the grateful Samaritan.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 18

<div class="key-verse">Luke 18:27</div>

<div class="identifier">The things impossible with men are possible with God</div>

### Why This Verse

Divine possibility

### Chapter Insight

This chapter contains teachings on persistent prayer, humility, and salvation. The key verse emphasizes humble dependence upon God rather than self-righteousness.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 19

<div class="key-verse">Luke 19:10</div>

<div class="identifier">The Son of man is come to seek and save the lost</div>

### Why This Verse

Key summary of Jesus' mission

### Chapter Insight

This chapter records Zacchaeus' conversion and Jesus' triumphal entry. The key verse summarizes Jesus' mission to seek and save the lost.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 20

<div class="key-verse">Luke 20:25</div>

<div class="identifier">Render unto Caesar the things which are Caesar's</div>

### Why This Verse

Church and state principle

### Chapter Insight

This chapter contains confrontations with religious leaders. The key verse highlights Jesus' authority and wisdom in exposing false motives.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 21

<div class="key-verse">Luke 21:33</div>

<div class="identifier">Heaven and earth shall pass away</div>

### Why This Verse

Enduring words of Christ

### Chapter Insight

This chapter records the widow's offering and Jesus' teaching about future events. The key verse commends wholehearted devotion regardless of material resources.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 22

<div class="key-verse">Luke 22:42</div>

<div class="identifier">Not My will, but Thine, be done</div>

### Why This Verse

Gethsemane submission

### Chapter Insight

This chapter recounts the Last Supper, Jesus' arrest, and Peter's denial. The key verse establishes the New Covenant through Christ's sacrificial work.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 23

<div class="key-verse">Luke 23:34</div>

<div class="identifier">Father, forgive them</div>

### Why This Verse

One of Christ's most famous sayings

### Chapter Insight

This chapter records Jesus' trial, crucifixion, and death. The key verse reveals Christ's mercy even toward those responsible for His suffering.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 24

<div class="key-verse">Luke 24:6</div>

<div class="identifier">He is not here, but is risen</div>

### Why This Verse

Resurrection proclamation

### Chapter Insight

This chapter records the resurrection, the Emmaus road encounter, and Jesus' final instructions. The key verse proclaims the risen Christ and the mission to proclaim repentance and forgiveness to all nations.
:::
